user.title: Configure Home Energy Monitor
user.description: These values tune the battery forecast and live peak-import warning. The dashboard creates editable helpers with the same defaults.

data_description.battery_capacity_kwh: Usable bank capacity in kWh (recent cycles support approximately 28 kWh).
data_description.peak_import_threshold_kw: Sustained on-peak import that should produce an alert.
data_description.planning_discharge_kw: Conservative battery draw used before the rolling forecast is fully representative.
data_description.minimum_discharge_kw: Do not claim an ETA below this discharge rate.
